meta.title: Rainbow Six Siege Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert sensitivity from any FPS game to Rainbow Six Siege. Precise cm/360 based conversion.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_1: Enter your Rainbow Six Siege sensitivity
steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_1Des: Input your R6 Siege sensitivity. Found in Options → Controls → Mouse Sensitivity. Include your ADS sensitivity settings for more accurate conversion.
steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_2Des: Choose the game to convert to. R6 Siege's slower, methodical aiming differs from faster shooters — give yourself time to adjust to the new game's pace.
steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_3Des: Apply the converted value. Practice in terrorist hunt or training grounds to build muscle memory with the new sensitivity setting.
